what: SPEED-RT Cascade timing sets (the in-harness shot streams that replace seed kind 12). Stage 1 of SPEED-RT (both cards). No files are drawn: every Cascade process samples inside the run from the chunk seeds of speed_rt/sets.py (TAG 'convlines speed-rt <set>'), chunk j of a set being chunk j of the original stream eval_seed(12, p, j, family) (BB72) or eval_seed(13, 12, p, j) (d = 13). Stage 1's beacon record names this file (sets_file); if config.json ever holds srt-cas sets, srtlib.py refuses any whose identity fields differ from these.

srt-cas-uni-p2.feeds: R3 nets S55 and C14 (claim-point shots, chunks 0-9); chunks 10-49 feed nothing
